title: AdsNet: A Graph Neural Network for Direct Adsorption Energy Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fast and accurate prediction of adsorption energies is critical for high-throughput computational catalyst screening, existing methods compromise either on evaluation speed (full-graph machine learning potentials) or geometric sensitivity (coordination-based models like the alpha-scheme). Here, we present AdsNet, an equivariant graph neural network that directly predicts adsorption energies in a single forward pass, which operates on a local graph restricted only to adsorbate atoms and its immediate surface neighbors within a cutoff radius. This local graph formulation decouples computational complexity from total system size while encoding continuous geometric features (interatomic distances and directional vectors) enabling sensitivity to subtle variations in local bonding environments. translated_title: AdsNet：用于直接预测吸附能的图神经网络
translated_abstract: 快速且准确地预测吸附能对于高通量计算催化剂筛选至关重要，而现有方法要么在评估速度上有所妥协（全图机器学习势），要么在几何敏感性上有所妥协（如 alpha-scheme 等基于配位数的模型）。在此，我们提出了 AdsNet，这是一种等变图神经网络，能够在单次前向传播中直接预测吸附能。它仅在一个局部图上运行，该图只包含吸附质原子及其截断半径内的直接表面近邻。这种局部图表示将计算复杂度与体系总规模解耦，同时编码连续的几何特征（原子间距离和方向矢量），从而对局部成键环境的细微变化保持敏感。AdsNet 采用消息传递架构，在多个相互作用层中使用标量和矢量节点特征。该模型在 AdsTraj 数据集上训练，该数据集包含……
tldr: AdsNet 是一种等变图神经网络，通过仅基于吸附质原子及其近邻表面原子的局部图，在单次前向传播中直接快速且准确地预测吸附能，其计算复杂度与体系规模解耦，非常适合高通量催化剂筛选。
en_tdlr: AdsNet is an equivariant graph neural network that directly predicts adsorption energies in a single forward pass using a local graph of only adsorbate atoms and their nearby surface neighbors, decoupling computational cost from system size for high-throughput catalyst screening.
